name: @koryei/remy
description: Remy: one calm assistant for real digital work, in your terminal.

scripts.bundle: esbuild src/run.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=esm --conditions=@remy/source --external:ink --external:playwright-core --external:react --external:'react/*' --banner:js="import{createRequire as __remyRequire}from'node:module';const require=__remyRequire(import.meta.url);" --outfile=release/main.js --log-level=warning && node scripts/write-bin.mjs
